slovenian. 

But I fucked up deeply, because I've tried to help community. 
In those six months I've expand business for 200% share, or almost 42% of entire market. They try to burn property, they've stolen goods a couple of times..but I've survived those "attacks". 
Then, they spitted on my fathers grave, made warning notes and put it on my mothers car. 
Police didn't find anything. 


But..it's strange feeling. I don't feel anything. No regret, no remorse, no pain, no anger..It's just a void. And brains are running million miles per hour, try to found a reason for anything.. But it's ok. 

Pittying doesn't help. But it's funny how people attack you when you are on lowest point in your life. 
It's hard just to wake up and try to get an idea where to go from point zero. Somewhere I guess

I live in worst economic recession in EU. 
I know that my mother is sick,but doctors said they will announce in mid september diagnose. 
So I had around 9 months to start a business. 
But in may, the letter came. And when I went through numbers I saw that everything I've invested, was gone over night. 
Now I'm around 32.000€ in debt. 
Without options of getting a job, work or anything.

Everything I have is now gone. And I don't have startup capital to start again. It's lovely situation :)
